after_record.title: Full-channel overlap forces quadratic repair unless leading column maps collapse
after_record.statement: For Q(n,m), m>=2, suppose each long map has fixed injective routing of source polynomial columns to target outer coordinates and arbitrary regular m-by-m channel matrices. Let N count the product of covered source first indices, G the corresponding product from invertible leading channel blocks, and c the product of connected-component counts of good full-window source-column positions, with edges at distance<m. Any formal degeneration Q(n,m) direct_sum R to M(l,m,r), with arbitrary Laurent first and auxiliary maps, requires first_flattening_rank(R) and border_rank(R) at least max(0,lr-N+G-c). The contributions may be separately polar. With fixed m and l/n,r/n tending to one, o(n) singular leading channel blocks force n^2-o(n^2) repair cost. Full channel rank is allowed.
dependencies: Maintained Q(n,m) source convention and fixed-width correction criterion, pinned in sources.json
PR211 auxiliary-kernel normalization, with its original credit and no low-channel-rank hypothesis
Exact coefficient-window overlap, rational slice-plane reconstruction and a saturated-limit dimension budget
after_record.limitations: Fixed injective routing; distinct polynomial columns do not mix on either long leg. Channel blocks are regular formal series. Extensive leading singularity and general column-mixing maps remain open. The full-channel example is sharp for the first-flattening bound only. No independent review, formalization, historical priority or improved exponent.

after_record.title: Sharp dimension forty for all independent coordinate compressions of the A4 outer space
after_record.statement: Over C, every independent deletion of two output coordinates and two input coordinates from the explicit 46-dimensional outer space E=G+[G,F]+FGF has image dimension at least 40. Complete finite replay covers all 142884 pairs modulo 1009; exact integer six-dimensional kernel witnesses attain dimension 40 at exactly the two stated pairs. The preceding bottom-left kernel reduction then bounds every independent coordinate rank-110 long-leg compression of the complete fixed conjugation limit by a loss of at most six leading directions, below the nine required for M(10,10,11).

Complete finite modular-rank lower-bound census and exact integer kernel identities
after_record.limitations: Finite computer-assisted theorem for independently selected coordinate deletions in the specified normalized basis and one fixed conjugation family. It does not exclude arbitrary noncoordinate flags or other singular paths. Modular ranks are used only as complex lower bounds; exact sharpness is separately proved. No target construction, independent mathematical review, formalization or exponent improvement.

after_record.title: Sharp all-field rank-two first-slice gap for paired convolution source
after_record.statement: For any field, integers n>=2 and b>=1, and rank-two n-by-n first parameter Y of Q(n,b), the ordinary first contraction has rank at least b(b+1); this is attained by Y=E00+E11. For two polynomial-multiplication pencils of full projective row/column rank with right/left Kronecker minimal index partitions (e_i) and (d_j), respectively, its exact matrix rank is b^2+sum_ij min(e_i,d_j).

Does not apply to arbitrary rank-two contraction limits without their source realization, establish a source-to-target map, strengthen general Laurent repair bounds, or improve the omega<=9/4 baseline. Finite controls are not independent external review.

after_record.title: Three-term cyclic-source biform ranks are not determined by primitive degrees and pairwise resultants
after_record.statement: The literal 15x15 cyclic-source matrix R_(3,3)(x^2+z(1+x^2)+z^2(1+t*x+c*x^2)) has determinant t(2c^3-2ct^2+t^4) in Z[c,t]. Over every field of characteristic not 2, the triples (x^2,1+x^2,1+2x^2) and (x^2,1+x^2,1+x+x^2) each have degree pattern (2,2,2), primitive triple degree 2, and all three pairwise resultants exactly 1, but their ranks are respectively 14 and 15. For the former a nonzero integer row-kernel vector and a -4 minor witness rank14, while the latter has determinant 1.

after_record.title: All-field exact rank formula for biforms with constant lower coefficients and one polynomial top coefficient
after_record.statement: For every field K, integers a>=2 and 1<=e<b, constants c_0,...,c_(e-1) with c_0!=0, and nonzero polynomial w(x) of degree d<a, the literal cyclic-source coefficient matrix of f=c_0+...+c_(e-1)z^(e-1)+w(x)z^e has rank ab+sum_(j=0)^(e-1) min(b,d*floor((a+j)/e)). A polynomial-kernel basis from the e terminal entries has independent residue-triangular highest-degree vectors, proving the formula over arbitrary characteristic. 3372 finite modular full-matrix controls and 24 rational controls passed.
